name: How long does black mold remediation under a sink take?

mainEntity.name: How long does black mold remediation under a sink take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of black mold remediation under a sink depends largely on the severity of the infestation and the extent of water damage. For a small, contained mold issue with a clear moisture source, the process might take a day or two, including drying time. However, if the mold has spread significantly, requires demolition of affected materials, or involves complex leak repairs, the project could extend to several days. A professional inspection can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing the specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Black mold remediation under a sink can take one to several days, depending on the mold's severity, extent of water damage, and necessary repairs. A professional assessment provides an accurate timeline.
